name: User registration creates an account and redirects to onboarding
description: A new visitor fills in name, email, password, and region on the register page, submits the form, and is redirected to the onboarding flow.

planSteps.description: Type a unique name into the 'Your name' field
Type a unique test email address into the 'Email address' field
Type a password of at least 6 characters into the 'Password' field
Select the 'United States (EPA eGRID)' region button
Verify the page navigates to /onboarding and shows the heading 'Set up your footprint' or 'How do you get around?'
